meta.title: Try to purchase a dormant-locked PR line
gaps: Selecting a specific dormant-locked PR line by its lock icon rather than relying on the first available PR selection
The Unlock or Request to unlock action and the resulting "Unlock request sent successfully" confirmation
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Selecting a specific dormant-locked PR line by its lock icon rather than relying on the first available PR selection; The Unlock or Request to unlock action and the resulting "Unlock request sent successfully" confirmation

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen as the buyer.
Use the Open tab, where a PR line can be selected for sourcing.
Select the available PR; the test data is expected to provide the dormant-locked line.
Assert that the Purchase Items control remains disabled for the selected dormant-locked line.
Hover the disabled Purchase Items control to reveal its explanation.

args.text: Dormant locked PR cannot be purchased

steps.note: Verify the exact dormant-lock tooltip message.
Try the disabled action and verify that it is refused rather than opening sourcing.
